result.title: DRA-SAM: Disagreement-Driven Referential Active SAM for Low-Altitude Drone Referring Segmentation
result.summary: Referring segmentation in low-altitude drone imagery requires distinguishing small, visually similar instances under complex linguistic and spatial constraints. Global inference may yield multiple plausible masks or leave the intended referent insufficiently represented, motivating selective local re-inference. We propose DRA-SAM, a disagreement-driven framework that allocates an additional inference pass according to competing referential hypotheses and an unresolved state. A lightweight EvidenceScorer estimates beliefs over existing candidates and the unresolved state. A training-free Referential Disagreement LOOK policy balances belief-weighted candidate competition and unresolved-region coverage to select a crop for local re-inference. The same benchmark-adapted SAM3-I backbone processes the selected region, and the resulting evidence updates existing hypotheses and introduces new candidates. Among the compared methods, DRA-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on six of seven test metrics on both RIS-LAD and UAVid-RIS, including mIoU and P@0.5-P@0.9, and on all seven RIS-LAD validation metrics. On RIS-LAD, DRA-SAM improves the matched global SAM3-I baseline from 49.55 to 52.34 mIoU and from 46.80 to 58.05 P@0.5. On UAVid-RIS, the independently adapted DRA-SAM achieves 73.26 mIoU and 86.86 P@0.5. Controlled crop-policy comparisons demonstrate the effectiveness of disagreement-guided crop selection, while target-size analysis reveals particularly pronounced gains for aerial targets occupying less than 1% of an image. These results establish referential disagreement as an effective criterion for allocating local inference. Code is available at https://github.com/phy709/DRA-SAM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DRA-SAM，面向低空无人机指代分割：用轻量 EvidenceScorer 在已有候选与「未解决」状态上给出信念分布，再由免训练的 Referential Disagreement LOOK 策略依据候选竞争与未覆盖区域选择裁剪块做一次局部重推理，并将新证据回写候选集。在 RIS-LAD 与 UAVid-RIS 上多数指标达 SOTA，小目标（占图 <1%）增益尤为明显。
AI.relevance_reason: 与「LOOK 何时看哪里」及证据获取、信念状态更新直接相关，可供核查分歧/未解决状态作为选择性局部计算触发信号的效力；但其额外推理轮次固定为一次，未含明确的 STOP 判据，也未涉及 latent 状态生成，阅读时需区分其收益来源。
